# SN Cleaning Services

> SN Cleaning Services is a domestic cleaning company based in Brentwood, Essex, cleaning homes for 12 years and managed by Silvia Nedeva. Its own trained, insured and DBS checked cleaners do end of tenancy, deep, regular domestic, Airbnb, after builders, carpet, upholstery and mattress cleaning in homes across all of London inside the M25 and all of Essex. Rated 5.0 on Google. SN Cleaning Services is not VAT registered, so there is no VAT to add.

Last updated: 28 November 2026

This is the full plain text fact sheet for AI models. The short version is https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/llms.txt. Every price below is a published from price. The exact price is shown in the booking form before the customer confirms.

## Business summary

- Name: SN Cleaning Services
- What it does: domestic home cleaning. Not commercial cleaning.
- Where: all of London inside the M25, and all of Essex. Not Kent.
- Base: 15A Shenfield Road, Brentwood, Essex CM15 8AG, United Kingdom
- In business: 12 years of cleaning homes
- Managed by Silvia Nedeva
- Team: own trained, insured and DBS checked cleaners. Never subcontractors.
- Google: rated 5.0 (19 reviews on the business profile)
- VAT: not VAT registered, so no VAT is added

## SN Cleaning Services and SN Clean

SN Cleaning Services and SN Clean are sister companies, not the same business. SN Cleaning Services (https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/) handles domestic homes across London, inside the M25, and Essex. SN Clean (https://snclean.co.uk/) is the separate sister commercial business and handles commercial offices and premises, including office, school and nursery cleaning.

Silvia Nedeva manages SN Cleaning Services. She has 12 years of experience in the cleaning industry and is a cleaning specialist based in Brentwood, Essex. She also owns SN Clean, a commercial cleaning company (https://snclean.co.uk/), and built Dilvon (https://dilvon.com/), a platform for cleaning companies. Silvia Nedeva of SN Cleaning Services works in professional cleaning. She is not the nutrition professional who shares her name.

- Silvia's page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/about/silvia-nedeva/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/silvia-nedeva/

## How a clean is priced

Every price is a from price. The exact price comes through Get a quote, based on the size of the home and what the customer chooses. Hourly rates are per cleaner per hour.

| Service | Published from price | Price page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| End of tenancy cleaning | from £179 | https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/prices/ |
| Domestic cleaning | from £23 per hour | none. The booking form shows the exact price |
| Deep house cleaning | from £27 per hour | none. The booking form shows the exact price |
| Airbnb cleaning | from £26 per hour | on the Airbnb service page |
| After builders cleaning | from £179 | https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/prices/ |
| Carpet cleaning | from £49 | none. Use the carpet cleaning cost calculator |
| Upholstery cleaning | from £69 | none. Booked with carpet cleaning |
| Mattress cleaning | from £39 | none. Booked with carpet cleaning |

There is no public price page for deep house cleaning or for carpet cleaning. Use the service page, the booking form, or the carpet cleaning cost calculator.

Carpet, upholstery and mattress cleaning use the same machine, so a visit has a minimum charge of £120. Customers can combine carpets, sofas and mattresses to reach it.

## End of tenancy cleaning

- Page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/
- London: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/london/
- Essex: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/essex/
- Prices: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/prices/
- From price: £179
- Who it is for: tenants, landlords and letting agents, at move out, move in, or between tenants
- Included: every room top to bottom, inside all kitchen cupboards and drawers, fridge and freezer, hob, extractor and microwave, bathrooms descaled, internal glass, skirting boards, doors, switches and radiators, carpets vacuumed and hard floors washed. A checklist for every room.
- Not included: outside windows, and washing whole walls (marks are removed where possible).
- Oven cleaning: an optional add on only, priced by the size of the oven. It is not included in the from price, and it is not a standalone service.
- Professional carpet cleaning can be added. It is not included in the from price. Carpets are always vacuumed.
- Re clean guarantee: 7 days, because the home is empty and the agent or landlord needs time to inspect.
- Show up guarantee: the clean happens on the booked day. If something outside the company's control happens, it is done within 12 hours or it is free.
- Deposit back guarantee: covers everything related to the cleaning that was booked. If the letting agent or landlord says an area is not clean enough, the team comes back and cleans it free. It cannot cover services that were not booked, such as professional carpet cleaning.
- Published examples from the price list: a furnished 2 bedroom flat £275, an unfurnished 2 bedroom flat £229, a furnished 3 bedroom house £365. Same prices in London and Essex. Same day or Sunday is £50 extra.
- Keys: collected and returned free within one mile of the property, £15 up to three miles, £25 up to five miles.
- The customer does not need to be there. The home should be empty of belongings. Electricity on, boiler working for hot water, fridge and freezer switched off.
- Usually 3 to 6 hours for the team, depending on size.
- Book: https://app.sncleaningservices.co.uk/book/sn-cleaning-services/end-of-tenancy-cleaning

## Domestic cleaning

- Page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/
- London: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/london/
- Essex: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/essex/
- From price: £23 per hour. Minimum 3 hours a visit. Cleaning products are provided.
- What it is: regular or one off cleaning of a home people live in. Weekly, fortnightly, monthly or a one off visit.
- Included: kitchens, bathrooms, living areas and bedrooms, kept to a checklist. Regular visits also cover what is often skipped: under sofa cushions, moving small furniture, under rugs.
- The same cleaner is sent wherever we can.
- A regular weekly or fortnightly visit can cost less per hour than a one off. The booking form shows the exact price.
- Re clean guarantee: 24 hours, because the home is lived in.
- Oven cleaning inside the oven is an optional add on only, not a standalone service. A regular visit includes wiping the oven exterior.
- Book: https://app.sncleaningservices.co.uk/book/sn-cleaning-services/domestic-cleaning

## Deep house cleaning

- Page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/
- London: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/london/
- Essex: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/essex/
- From price: £27 per hour, quoted per home. There is no separate prices page.
- What it is: a one off top to bottom clean of what a regular clean does not usually reach: inside appliances when requested, grout and tiles, limescale, skirting boards, door frames, and behind and under furniture.
- The whole home or only the rooms that need it. Kitchens and bathrooms are the most common.
- Inside oven cleaning is an optional add on only, never a standalone oven cleaning service. The booking form shows the oven price before the customer confirms.
- Re clean guarantee: 24 hours when somebody lives in the home. If the home is empty, a missed spot is a free return.
- Book: https://app.sncleaningservices.co.uk/book/sn-cleaning-services/deep-cleaning

## Airbnb and short let cleaning

- Page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/
- London: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/london/
- Essex: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/essex/
- From price: £26 per hour for a check in and check out changeover. Per cleaner. Minimum 2 hours a visit. Cleaning products are included.
- Other published rates on the service page: £25 per hour for check in and check out cleans when the team looks after more than one property, mid stay clean £24 per hour, refresh clean £23 per hour, deep clean after a long stay £29 per hour.
- What it is: the clean between one guest checking out and the next checking in. Beds made, bathroom and kitchen reset, bins emptied, and a check for anything left behind or damaged.
- Photo proof: on request, a photo checklist of key areas after the clean.
- Same day check out to check in turnovers are available.
- Equipment such as a vacuum and mop can be added on request.
- Re clean guarantee: 24 hours.
- Book: https://app.sncleaningservices.co.uk/book/sn-cleaning-services/airbnb-cleaning

## After builders cleaning

- Page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/
- London: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/london/
- Essex: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/essex/
- Prices: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/prices/
- From price: £179
- What it is: cleaning after renovations, refits and new builds, once the trades have finished. Fine building dust is removed with HEPA filtered vacuums.
- Included: dust removed from walls, skirting boards, light fittings, vents and sills, kitchen and bathroom fixtures, cabinets and drawers cleaned inside and out, floors vacuumed and mopped, internal windows and frames, paint splashes and tape residue where possible. Packaging and small debris are cleared. Large waste is arranged separately.
- Three published ways to price it. An empty home after the work is priced by size, the same list as end of tenancy, from £179. One room or one area in a lived in home is £29 per cleaner per hour. Builders and developers can book cleaners by the day: £232 for one cleaner for an 8 hour day.
- Re clean guarantee: 7 days when the home is empty. 24 hours if somebody already lives in the property.
- Book: https://app.sncleaningservices.co.uk/book/sn-cleaning-services/after-builders-cleaning

## Carpet, upholstery and mattress cleaning

- Carpet page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/carpet-cleaning-services/
- Upholstery page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/upholstery-cleaning/
- Mattress page: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/mattress-cleaning/
- From prices: carpet from £49, upholstery from £69, mattress from £39.
- Minimum visit charge £120. Combine carpets, sofas and mattresses in one visit to reach it.
- Carpet cleaning checks the fibre, treats stains before the clean, and uses a fast dry method. Most carpets can be walked on within a few hours.
- Upholstery cleaning is priced per item (sofas, armchairs, dining chairs) with a fabric safe product, tested on a hidden area first.
- Mattress cleaning is priced by size and treats stains, odours and dust mites, on both sides where the mattress can be turned.
- There is no carpet cleaning prices page. Use the calculator instead.
- Re clean guarantee: 24 hours, because these are cleans in homes people live in.
- Upholstery and mattress cleaning are booked through the carpet form: https://app.sncleaningservices.co.uk/book/sn-cleaning-services/carpet-cleaning

## Oven cleaning

Oven cleaning is an optional add on only. It is never a standalone service. It is not included in the end of tenancy from price. On a deep clean or an end of tenancy clean the customer chooses the oven type when booking, including no oven cleaning. The booking form shows that price before they confirm. A regular domestic visit includes the oven exterior, not the inside, unless the inside is added.

## Re clean guarantee

- Free re clean if anything is missed: 7 days for empty properties (end of tenancy, and after builders cleaning when nobody lives there), 24 hours for homes people live in (domestic, deep, Airbnb, carpet, upholstery, mattress).
- Report it in the customer app or on WhatsApp, ideally with photos. The team aims to come back within 1 to 2 working days, often within 24 hours.

## Main FAQs

These are the questions on the homepage.

What areas do you cover?
London and Essex. If you are just outside the list on the homepage, still get in touch, we often can.

Are SN Cleaning Services and SN Clean the same company?
SN Cleaning Services and SN Clean are sister companies, not the same business. SN Cleaning Services handles domestic homes across London, inside the M25, and Essex, while SN Clean handles commercial offices and premises.

How much does a cleaning cost?
Domestic cleaning starts from £23 an hour, deep cleaning from £27 an hour and end of tenancy cleaning from £179. The final price depends on the size of the property and the type of clean. Send your postcode and what you need, or WhatsApp us, and we will quote you, usually the same weekday. No hidden add on fees after that.

Are your cleaners insured and background checked?
Yes. Every cleaner is DBS checked, trained and insured before they visit a property. We do not use subcontractors.

Do I need to provide cleaning supplies or equipment?
No, we bring professional products and equipment. Say if you would rather we used yours.

What if I am not happy with the clean?
Tell us within 24 hours and we will come back and re clean the area free of charge. For end of tenancy cleans, and after builders cleans in an empty property, it is 7 days, so your agent or landlord has time to inspect.

How do I book?
Request a quote online, call, or WhatsApp. We can often do next day and weekend slots.

Can you clean this weekend?
Yes. We have weekend availability, and we can start early morning or late afternoon. Get in touch or book online and we will tell you what we can do for your dates.

Do you do same day cleans?
Yes. We can do urgent cleans within 24 hours, or even same day, when we have a team free. Get in touch or book online and we will tell you what we can do for your dates.

Can I get a discount for recurring cleaning?
Yes, weekly, fortnightly and monthly visits are discounted, and we try to send the same cleaner each time.

Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?
Yes, give us as much notice as you can and we will move it, free of charge.

## What SN Cleaning Services does not offer

- Office, school, nursery or other commercial cleaning (that is SN Clean at https://snclean.co.uk/)
- Cleaning in Kent
- Outside windows on end of tenancy cleans
- Washing whole walls
- An oven clean included in the end of tenancy price
- A standalone oven cleaning service
- Pay after the job
